description: This file defines the interface for USP record-related functions, including connection creation and disconnection handling, typically used in network communication contexts such as WebSocket, MQTT, STOMP, and UDS. It also includes proper licensing and include guards.

methods.name: USPREC_WebSocketConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket connection with the specified endpoint ID and message send item.

methods.name: USPREC_MqttConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates an MQTT connection with the specified endpoint ID, MQTT version, agent topic, and message send item.

methods.name: USPREC_StompConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a STOMP connection with the specified endpoint ID, destination, and message send item.

methods.name: USPREC_UdsConnect_Create
methods.description: Creates a UDS connection with the specified endpoint ID and message send item.

methods.name: USPREC_Disconnect_Create
methods.description: Handles disconnection by specifying content type, endpoint ID, reason code, and optional reason string, along with message send item.
